verdict.rationale: Undermind lets researchers shape a run's scope before it starts: it asks clarifying follow-up questions, and users report this refined their questions. Resubmitting a similar search continues from existing results, which extends the run. However, depth and effort are set by the engine itself, which plans its own searches and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers, and there is no evidence of steering a run while it executes. Missing for 10: explicit user-set depth/effort controls, mid-run steering or interruption, documented scope parameters for deep research runs, and independent corroboration of steering controls.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes

citations.quote: Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Resubmitting a similar search continues from existing results
Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
